ConfigurableProduct:14882.name: Sketchpads
ConfigurableProduct:14882.meta_title: Personalised Sketchpads | Custom drawing sketchpads for kids
ConfigurableProduct:14882.meta_description: Stimulate your child's imagination with this customised sketchpad featuring quality blank pages on which to create art. Design your sketchpad online today!
ConfigurableProduct:14882.faq:
How will my order be printed?

Each Sketchpad will be custom printed for you with a quality 350gsm laminated card stock for the cover, along with your chosen design and personalisation details.

Does the Sketchpad come binded?

Sure does! The Sketchpad is bound with a plastic coil binding, meaning you can keep all the pages intact, or tear out pages to put on display.

Do you use quality paper?

Yes, our stock is 120gsm, which means you can draw with pencils and textas without marking the following page.

description.html:
Personalised, thick cover printed on 350gsm card stock. Choose from an assortment of fun and lively designs!

Quality 120gsm paper is appropriate for pencils, markers, crayons, and more. Colour will not soak through this quality paper. Pages can be torn out and displayed, or kept in the pad.

This personalised Sketchpad will be custom printed especially for you in a landscape layout with the option to choose between an A5 (14.8cm x 21cm), A4 (21cm x 29.7cm) or A3 (29.7cm x 42cm) size.

Looking for more educational products? Check out our range of personalised Educational Posters, Activity Books, Routine Planners, Reward Charts & Learn To Type Labels.

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double check your spelling.

short_description_right.html:
• Personalised front cover
  • 30 blank pages
  • Premium quality 120gsm paper stock
  • White coil binding
  • A5, A4 or A3 size options

short_description.html:
Perfect for the child who loves to draw, our Sketchpads are a great way to encourage imagination and creativity. Choose from a wide array of designs to suit your little one's personality and style.

Sketchpads are available in various sizes, and contain 30 pages of premium, smooth, bright white paper on which to create your masterpiece. Heavy pages prevent bleed through, and result in vivid artworks.
